ceiling.method: naive Bayes carrying the generator's own parameters, which is the optimal rule because the features are drawn independently given the label; missing values contribute no term
ceiling.caveat: the generator clips each feature, so the true density is not normal at the bounds. The share of values sitting on a bound is recorded above, and the ceiling is an estimate on a finite sample rather than a closed form

data.source: generated by src/generate_data.py; no measurement, no external dataset, no laboratory record

split.note: imputer and scaler live inside each Pipeline, so both are fitted on the training fold only and never see the data they are scored against

bayes_optimal.label: the generator's own rule, not a trained model

selection.criterion: mean F1 over 5-fold stratified cross-validation on the training split
selection.note: the test split was scored once per model and selected nothing

model_confidence.note: distance from 0.5, so larger means more confident
